text: A right, slightly different from each other, and that difference is what makes music feel wide. Headphones keep them apart, left side to your left ear, right side to your right. title: The 10-second mono check fix before exporting
text: Cancel. You don't lose the whole layer. You lose holes out of it. That is why a folded-down mix usually sounds hollow rather than silent. The fix costs 10 seconds. Before you export, switch your track to mono and listen once. If the vocal jumps forward and the air disappears, you have found it. The usual culprits are stereo wideners, doubled parts, and wide reverb on something that should be sitting in the center. Most people will hear your track on one speaker. Check it there before you call it finished. I'm Rohan Vijayakumar for Humanitarian's AI.
